fato_historico: 1987: A coup d'état in Burkina Faso overthrows and kills then President Thomas Sankara.
energia_do_dia: Today may invite you to reflect on the tides of change. Much like a shift in leadership in distant lands once reshaped a nation's path, you are being called to redefine your personal sovereignty. It is a good time to release outdated structures and embrace the gentle, revolutionary power of your own empathy to heal and inspire those around you.
frase_do_dia: True change blooms when we lead with an open, courageous, and compassionate heart.
significado_numero: Represents the awakening of spiritual intuition and personal inner wisdom.
conselho: Consider letting go of old patterns to welcome fresh, intuitive opportunities today.
